# CosMix component versions

*Generated by `_bin/gen-versions.mix` — do not edit. Every number below is
read from a `Cargo.toml` at generation time, so this file cannot disagree
with the source tree.*

This is the single source of truth for CosMix component versions, online at
<https://cosmix.dev/VERSIONS>. Project docs deliberately do **not** state
current versions — a version in prose rots, and a stale one reads as
authoritative. Docs still carry *capability floors* ("needs mix >= 0.46.0")
and *history* ("strict since v0.52.0"), because those describe what happened
and never go out of date.

**What is deployed is not stated here.** Which host runs which build is
answered by the host, not by a document:

```sh
ssh <node> 'print(run("/opt/cosmix/bin/mix --version"))'
```
